name: odia_ocr_benchmark_data
description: A dataset of images and transcriptions for OCR of Odia (Oriya) script, intended to measure OCR systems' ability to recognize printed and/or handwritten Odia text from images. It is used to evaluate character- and word-level recognition accuracy for Indic-script OCR models and to support development of language-specific OCR pipelines. Typical evaluations report character- and word-error rates and exact-match transcription accuracy.
evaluation_method: character_error_rate (CER) and word_error_rate (WER), plus exact_match for full-line or full-page transcriptions
reputation: A niche but useful dataset for the Odia OCR community hosted on Hugging Face; adoption is modest compared to major-script OCR benchmarks.
